candidate: Explicit BlindSearch::prune_preview_aliases call before any search steps; own root only. No production caller.
guard: Team preview; own full roster has no Beat Up, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch or Transform in either base or current move slots. Only legal three-member actions with swapped bench positions are merged. Existing masks and external action indices are preserved.
selection: All 24 catalog teams, each versus the next catalog team cyclically, acting as side index modulo 2. One fresh search seed per matchup.
arm_order: Alternating by catalog index plus repeat index; sequential measured searches.
timing: Native construction plus root reduction plus search, excluding belief creation, serialization and destruction. Shared host; not iPad timing.
comparison: Normalize the two selected bench slots before counting changed choices. Repetition tests deterministic reproducibility, not independent strength samples.

next_stage_screen.meaning: Feasibility for a fresh full-game experiment only; no quality or adoption claim.
